fusions.name: Defoliate
fusions.desc: Pays 5% of your maximum health to shed your leaves in a devouring cone, dealing 8 damage to everything in it, with a 25% chance to leave each [Weakened] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Grub-Eaten Pinecone
fusions.desc: Throws a pinecone hollowed by grubs that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets. Your afflictions on it spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Leaf Swarm
fusions.desc: Looses a swarm of chewing leaves for 12 seconds that strikes enemies within 3 tiles for 3 damage every second.

fusions.name: Regrowth After Ruin
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 6 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
